_description: T19 (mechanism, distance + filter): configs/t19_dist.json plus cuckoo-filter guidance of the victim/chunk choice. No mi200 or hpca parameter is changed.
_t19-filter: Per-GPM recent-page cuckoo filter (aging by deletion) and per WG-group footprint cuckoo filters recorded on the first launch of a kernel (replaced when the pattern changes). Near candidates are ranked by footprint overlap, then group / WG-index affinity, then distance.
_t19-rpf-log2-buckets: Recent-page filter: 512 buckets x 4 slots, 12-bit fingerprints, keeps the last 1024 distinct pages.
_t19-group-log2-buckets: Group footprint filter: 64 buckets x 4 slots (fingerprint + 3 extra hash bits + primary flag = 16 bits per entry); 64 groups per home GPM, LRU.
_t19-group-wgs: 0 = chunk size; a benchmark group hint overrides it.
